title: Refine accessibility for custom controls
description: Unlock the full potential of your app’s interactive elements by making them accessible to everyone. We’ll break down how people understand and use controls with VoiceOver and other assistive technologies, exploring a variety of input methods like actions, the passthrough gesture, and direct touch. Join us for an in-depth exploration of several example controls as we refine and elevate the accessibility experience in each one.
